info.title: API.SH: Maven Central
info.description: The Maven Central API from API.SH: public Maven Central data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

get.description:
One artifact: description, latest version and release, every-version count, last update, licenses, categories, usage by organizations and applications, dependency and dependent counts, plus the POM summary of the requested (or latest) version: name, homepage, organization, developers (names and roles), source repository, issue tracker, parent, and ready-to-paste Maven and Gradle snippets.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maven-central-artifact

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artifact as group:artifact (com.google.guava:guava), optionally :version, or a central.sonatype.com / mvnrepository.com / repo1.maven.org link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version (default: the latest release).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

The resolved dependencies of one version (direct and transitive), each with version, scope, description, licenses and how many artifacts use it. Filter by `type` and by text. 20 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maven-central-dependencies

parameters.name: id

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version (default: the latest release).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: all (default), direct or transitive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only dependencies matching these words.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` gives the next one; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit

get.description:
The parsed POM of one version: coordinates, packaging, name, description, homepage, parent, licenses, organization, developers and contributors (names, roles, organizations), source repository, issue and CI systems, modules, properties, declared dependencies (scope, type, classifier, optional, exclusions), dependency management, build plugins and repositories. Add `xml=true` for the original XML.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maven-central-pom

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artifact as group:artifact (com.google.guava:guava), optionally :version, or a central.sonatype.com / mvnrepository.com / repo1.maven.org link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version (default: the latest release).

parameters.name: xml
parameters.description: true to include the original POM XML.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Maven Central (Java, Kotlin, Scala and other JVM libraries) by text, namespace (group id) or category. Each artifact comes with its latest version and publish time, licenses, categories, how many organizations and applications use it, dependency and dependent counts, file types and packaging. 20 per page; pass `next_page` back as `page`, null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maven-central-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when namespace or category is given).

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Only artifacts in this group id (exact), e.g. org.apache.commons.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Only artifacts in this category (see /maven-central/v1/categories), e.g. Build Tools.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default with q), popularity (organizations using it; default without q), published, name or namespace.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: asc or desc (default desc; asc for name and namespace).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` gives the next one; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-20 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every version of an artifact with its publish time (newest first by default), plus the latest release and last update. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/maven-central-versions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Artifact as group:artifact (com.google.guava:guava), optionally :version, or a central.sonatype.com / mvnrepository.com / repo1.maven.org link.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: desc (newest first, default) or asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). `next_page` gives the next one; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per page, 1-500 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
